newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at Sept Brent -7 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at Sept Brent -7 cents.

text.p: Dated Brent traded for a second time on Thursday, with an August 26-28 loader sold at seven cents below September Brent, two cents cheaper than the earlier deal, traders said.
The first trade at -5 cents was for an August 27-29 cargo, not August 28-30 as originally reported.
Buyers and sellers were the same for both deals. Both Aug 29-31
cargoes due to turn wet on Thursday, the last from the August programme, were kept early by equity holders Shell and Exxon, the traders said.
